items.title: 30.4.3 D2O exchange se O-H aur N-H protons pehchanna (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 30.4.3 with Quick Check 30.4 answered (PDF 209); the before-and-after sketch is ours. Answers need review.

blocks.text: O-H (alcohols ya carboxylic acids) aur N-H (amines ya amides) ke hydrogen atoms aasani se exchange ho (badal) jate hain. Isi wajah se un ki singlet peak ki chemical shift value kaafi wide (bari) range mein kahin bhi aa sakti hai.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Ethanol ka Hᵃ (pink) aur paani ka Hᵇ (blue) jagah badal lete hain. Yeh exchange (len-den) bohat tezi se hota hai, is liye O-H proton ki peak ki jagah pakki nahi rehti.

Kabhi kabhi spectrum mein in peaks ko pehchanna bohat mushkil ho jata hai. 'Deuterium exchange' ya 'D₂O shake' naam ki technique se pata chalaya jata hai ke ¹H NMR spectrum ka koi singlet waqai O-H ya N-H hydrogen ka hai ya nahi. Is tareeqe mein pehle compound ka ¹H NMR spectrum liya jata hai, jo molecule ke tamam H atoms, O–H ya N–H proton(s) samet, dikhata hai. Phir NMR sample tube mein D₂O ke kuch drops (qatre) dal kar solution ko achhi tarah hilaya jata hai aur spectrum dobara liya jata hai. Doosre spectrum mein O–H ya N–H proton wali peak ghaib ho jati hai. Dono spectra ko compare karne se confirm (pakka) ho jata hai ke woh peak N-H ya O-H ki thi.

Aisa is liye hota hai ke O ya N jaise bohat electronegative atoms se jure protons (¹H) aasani se exchange ho jate hain. Jab sample solution mein D₂O milaya jata hai to yeh hydrogens jaldi deuterium (D) atoms se exchange ho jate hain.

blocks.alt: Do spectra, delta 7 se 0. Oopar: ethanol ka spectrum, taqreeban 5.4 par O-H ki akeli peak, 3.6 par quartet aur 1.2 par triplet. Neeche: D2O shake ke baad wahi spectrum, lekin O-H wali peak ghaib hai; quartet aur triplet waise hi hain.
blocks.caption: D2O shake: pehle aur baad ka spectrum (is topic ke liye hamari apni drawing; kitab mein yeh figure nahi).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Oopar wale spectrum mein O-H ki akeli peak maujood hai; D₂O shake ke baad neeche wale spectrum mein woh ghaib hai, jab ke CH₂ ka quartet aur CH₃ ka triplet waise hi hain. Yeh drawing kitab mein nahi; samajhne ke liye banayi gayi hai.
Deuterium atom ko spin palatne ke liye ¹H se different energy chahiye, is liye ¹H NMR spectrum mein is ki peak nahi aati aur yeh 'invisible' (nazar na aane wala) ban jata hai.

blocks.prompt: a) D₂O shake ke baad O-H ya N-H peaks kyun ghaib ho jati hain?
blocks.explanation: O-H ya N-H ke hydrogens deuterium se badal jate hain (R–O–H + D₂O ⇌ R–O–D + HOD). Deuterium ¹H wali frequency par signal nahi deta, is liye woh peak ghaib ho jati hai.

blocks.prompt: b) (–CH₂CH₂NH₂) ke liye peak area aur splitting patterns (batne ke namoone) batayein.
blocks.explanation: Teen signals, areas 2:2:2. NH₂ ke saath wala CH₂ triplet (parosi CH₂ ke 2 H); NH₂ aam taur par broad (chauri) singlet (aur D₂O se ghaib); doosra CH₂ kam az kam triplet, aur zyada agar molecule ke baqi hisse mein us ke doosre parosi par bhi H ho.

items: O-H aur N-H protons aasani se exchange hote hain; un ki peak ki jagah pakki nahi.
D₂O shake: R–O–H + D₂O ⇌ R–O–D + HOD; O-H/N-H peak ghaib ho jati hai.
Deuterium ¹H spectrum mein nazar nahi aata.
